WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderflow,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.orderflow
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.orderflow,
  step1.avg_fillcount,
  step1.record_count,
  CAST(step1.record_count AS REAL) / step2.total_count as proportion
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY step1.orderflow
